```{r}
MODEL_data_new <- read_tsv("ALL_Combined_04032026.tsv", col_names = TRUE)
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)

# =========================
# 3D Distance group comparison
# =========================

# 1) Define group order and colors
group_order <- c(
  "C_H_M_H",
  "C_H_M_L",
  "C_L_M_H",
  "C_L_M_L"
)

custom_colors <- c(
  "C_H_M_H" = "#F28C9D",
  "C_H_M_L" = "#F3E065",
  "C_L_M_H" = "#65C9F3",
  "C_L_M_L" = "#9EAAE0"
)


# 2) Prepare data
df_combined <- MODEL_data_new %>%
  select(Group, `3D_Distance`) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Group),
    !is.na(`3D_Distance`)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = group_order
    ),
    Distance = `3D_Distance`
  ) %>%
  select(
    Group,
    Distance
  )


# 3) Mean per group
group_mean <- df_combined %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_distance = mean(
      Distance,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(group_mean)


# 4) Overall Kruskal-Wallis test
kw <- kruskal_test(
  df_combined,
  Distance ~ Group
)

print(kw)


# 5) Pairwise Wilcoxon tests
pairwise_res <- df_combined %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(
    Distance ~ Group,
    p.adjust.method = "fdr"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_label = case_when(
      p.adj < 0.0001 ~ "****",
      p.adj < 0.001  ~ "***",
      p.adj < 0.01   ~ "**",
      p.adj < 0.05   ~ "*",
      TRUE           ~ "ns"
    )
  )

print(pairwise_res)


# 6) Set bracket heights dynamically
y_top <- max(
  df_combined$Distance,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

y_bottom <- min(
  df_combined$Distance,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

step_val <- 0.05 * (
  y_top - y_bottom
)

if (step_val == 0) {
  step_val <- 0.1
}

pairwise_res$y.position <- y_top +
  step_val * seq_len(
    nrow(pairwise_res)
  )

label_y <- max(
  pairwise_res$y.position
) + step_val

mean_label_y <- y_top +
  step_val * 0.3


# 7) Plot
p <- ggplot(
  df_combined,
  aes(
    x = Group,
    y = Distance,
    fill = Group
  )
) +

  geom_violin(
    trim = TRUE,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +

  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.1,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = group_mean,
    aes(
      x = Group,
      y = mean_label_y,
      label = round(
        mean_distance,
        4
      )
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = 0,
    size = 5,
    color = "black",
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  stat_pvalue_manual(
    pairwise_res,
    label = "p_label",
    xmin = "group1",
    xmax = "group2",
    y.position = "y.position",
    tip.length = 0.01,
    bracket.size = 0.5,
    size = 5,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1.2,
    y = label_y,
    label = paste0(
      "Kruskal-Wallis, p = ",
      signif(
        kw$p,
        3
      )
    ),
    size = 5,
    hjust = 0
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = custom_colors
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "3D Distance Distribution Across Groups",
    x = "Group",
    y = "3D Distance"
  ) +

  theme_classic(
    base_size = 14
  ) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "none",

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 12,
      face = "bold",
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 12
    ),

    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 1
    )
  )

print(p)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# =========================
# Simple 3D distance violin plot
# directly from MODEL_data_new
# =========================

# 1) Group order
group_order <- c(
  "C_H_M_H",
  "C_H_M_L",
  "C_L_M_H",
  "C_L_M_L"
)


# 2) Colors
custom_colors <- c(
  "C_H_M_H" = "#F28C9D",
  "C_H_M_L" = "#F3E065",
  "C_L_M_H" = "#65C9F3",
  "C_L_M_L" = "#9EAAE0"
)


# 3) Prepare data
df_combined <- MODEL_data_new %>%
  select(
    Group,
    `3D_Distance`
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Group),
    !is.na(`3D_Distance`)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = group_order
    ),
    Distance = `3D_Distance`
  ) %>%
  select(
    Group,
    Distance
  )


# 4) Calculate group mean
group_mean <- df_combined %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_distance = mean(
      Distance,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(group_mean)


# 5) Position mean labels above distribution
distance_range <- range(
  df_combined$Distance,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

step_val <- diff(
  distance_range
) * 0.05

if (step_val == 0) {
  step_val <- 0.1
}

y_max <- max(
  df_combined$Distance,
  na.rm = TRUE
) + step_val


# 6) Plot
p <- ggplot(
  df_combined,
  aes(
    x = Group,
    y = Distance,
    fill = Group
  )
) +

  geom_violin(
    trim = TRUE,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +

  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.1,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = group_mean,
    aes(
      x = Group,
      y = y_max,
      label = round(
        mean_distance,
        4
      )
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = 0,
    size = 5,
    color = "black",
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = custom_colors
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "3D Distance Distribution Across Groups",
    x = "Group",
    y = "3D Distance"
  ) +

  theme_classic(
    base_size = 14
  ) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "none",

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 12,
      face = "bold",
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 12
    ),

    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 1
    )
  )

print(p)
```
